D.comparison: AI personalization of learning as project focus

O.outcome_detail: percentage of submissions by project type

cells.quote: Through an analysis of the submissions, two topics dominated as the focus: 1) Using AI to personalize learning, especially with a focus on making content culturally responsive (22%) and 2) providing teachers with assistance (25%) to reduce workload, provide real-time data to improve instruction, and/or responsive content generation to support with the development of materials such as lesson plans.
cells.note: This is a descriptive thematic analysis of RFI submissions, not an experimental comparison of treatments or learning outcomes; direction is therefore not applicable.

O.outcome_detail: classification precision

result.effect: Precision: ChatGPT-5.4 0.71, ChatGPT-5.4-mini 0.69, DeepSeek-V3 0.74; Random Forest 0.64, XGBoost 0.68

cells.quote: The zero-shot LLMs achieve relatively high precision but very low recall, making them too conservative for our application, where missing overlapping courses is more costly than false positives.
cells.note: The study reports 5-fold cross-validation performance, but this design does not map to the specified design categories.

O.outcome_detail: classification recall

cells.quote: The zero-shot LLMs achieve relatively high precision but very low recall, making them too conservative for our application, where missing overlapping courses is more costly than false positives.

O.outcome_detail: F1 score for identifying overlapping courses

result.effect: Random Forest F1 = 0.74 (±0.05); description threshold F1 = 0.69 (±0.11)

cells.quote: Among the evaluated machine learning models, Random Forest achieved the best overall performance on the TU/e Computer Science dataset and was therefore selected as the classifier used in CourseGraph.
cells.note: The study reports descriptive cross-validated scores but no significance test, equivalence test, or power analysis.

O.outcome_detail: F1 score for identifying overlapping courses

cells.quote: Random Forest and XGBoost provide the best balance between precision and recall, with F1 scores of 0.74 and 0.73, respectively.
cells.note: The numerical difference is descriptive; the text reports no significance test, equivalence test, or power analysis.

O.outcome_detail: Accuracy for identifying overlapping courses

cells.quote: The supervised NLP methods perform best overall.

D.treatment: submissions describing AI opportunities for inclusivity

O.outcome_detail: presence and themes of inclusivity opportunities in RFI responses

cells.quote: While fewer than five percent of submissions described the use of AI as opening new opportunities for inclusivity, those that did identified valuable tactics for the education field to consider.
cells.note: This is a descriptive thematic coding of RFI submissions, not an evaluated treatment-versus-comparison study; no learning outcome or comparative effect is reported.
